ratios.quote: At December 31, 2025, Caterpillar’s consolidated net worth was $21.388 billion, which was above the $9.000 billion required under the Credit Facility.

ratios.covenant_name: Cat Financial covenant interest coverage ratio
ratios.quote: At December 31, 2025, Cat Financial’s covenant interest coverage ratio was 1.53 to 1. This was above the 1.15 to 1 minimum ratio

ratios.covenant_name: Cat Financial six-month covenant leverage ratio (debt to net worth)
ratios.quote: In addition, at December 31, 2025, Cat Financial’s six-month covenant leverage ratio was 7.65 to 1 and year-end covenant leverage ratio was 8.21 to 1.

ratios.covenant_name: Cat Financial year-end covenant leverage ratio (debt to net worth)
ratios.quote: In addition, at December 31, 2025, Cat Financial’s six-month covenant leverage ratio was 7.65 to 1 and year-end covenant leverage ratio was 8.21 to 1.

parsed.notes: Consolidated net worth figures are in billions of dollars ($21.388B actual vs $9.000B minimum), not ratios. Cat Financial (a consolidated subsidiary and co-borrower under the Credit Facility) leverage covenants are debt to net worth, not debt to EBITDA. The six-month ratio is the average of month-end ratios over the six preceding months, and the year-end ratio is measured at December 31. The maximum is 10 to 1 for both. Interest coverage is calculated over the trailing four fiscal quarters. No borrowings were outstanding under the Credit Facility at December 31, 2025.
